lines.text: What changes when your contract moves to e-signature?
On paper, the same contract is printed, couriered, countersigned and filed, which takes about a week. With e-signature, both sides sign online, and it's filed in a few hours.
Three things are still on you. Confirm that each signer is authorised. Check the document type, because some deeds still need a witness. And keep the signing certificate with the contract.
The most common mistake is sending the draft instead of the final version. Lock the final PDF, and check it before you send.
In short, signing gets faster. The checks before you send stay the same.
Questions? Talk to your engagement lead.
